notes: 'shall give thanks unto' is one unit on יוֹדוּ, headed on the complement 'thanks' under rule 44's light-verb clause; the 'unto' is the preposition by which the English verb reaches its own object suffix (rule 44), not the suffix's, which keeps only 'thee'.
'O Jehovah' takes the supplied 'O' into the name's unit under rule 36.
כָּל מַעֲשֶׂיךָ is rendered attributively with the possessive under rule 28, so no 'of' is written for the chain.
